title: Precise synthesis of conjugated polymers via reducing homocoupling defects
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,1755-1791
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00644E, Review Article
Bowei Ma, Qinqin Shi, Hui Huang
This review elucidates mechanistic advances in the cross-coupling polymerizations enabling precision synthesis of alternating conjugated polymers, emphasizing the origin, suppression, and device-level impact of homocoupling defects.
